description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kohuwala, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520801
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status of various plots in different locations. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) without any government personnel changes or structural modifications.
